known_views: Most people feel agentic engineering is very hard, but if you understand the concepts everything else will be easy.
Clear agent roles and workflow design matter more than just using multiple LLMs in agentic engineering.
Giving each agent one clear responsibility is more important than simply adding more agents.
Good agentic systems are about clear responsibilities, not simply more agents.
The biggest mistake business development teams make when trying to integrate AI solutions is trying to automate everything immediately.
Quantum computing is better viewed as a specialized tool for certain problems, rather than a replacement for classical computers.
More complex models are not always better, data quality and problem formulation often matter more.
AI should augment security teams by detecting patterns and prioritizing threats while humans handle critical decisions.
